result.reason: The operative language supplies the preferred Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, Vendor legal violations, Vendor-caused data breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with customary notice, defense control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures. Omitting a Customer indemnity is more favorable to Customer and does not exceed the playbook limitation. The change is otherwise targeted and preserves unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because subsection (c) appears after the Section 10 heading while the comment says it was placed in Section 9, creating an internal placement/numbering inconsistency.
